sophie: Trade deadline chaos — can I offer my WR+pick for Jamal's RB? :grimacing:
jamal: what pick? also who's dropping who? :eyes:
sophie: thinking 2026 3rd. roster snapshot:
```
WRs: Lockett, Aiyuk, Watkins
RBs: Jacobs, ???
Bench: Ekeler, James Cook
```
jamal: lol you trying to gaslight an entire league. Ekeler + 3rd is tempting.
alex: vote: if it's Ekeler you're getting, say no. :laughing:
maria: i'd veto if it's clearly salary dodge. rules say no multi-asset? 
sophie: the league admin (sam) is out till the end of game night — @sam can we quick poll?
sam: I'm awake. put it to a quick poll, majority wins. also reminder: trade deadline midnight PST.
coach-bot: Trade clock: 5h 32m left. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jamal: ok here's counter — Ekeler + 2026 6th for Jacobs + 2026 3rd. Thoughts?
alex: seems fair. I'm :thumbsup:
maria: meh, Ekeler > Jacobs tho. :shrug:
sophie: i'll accept if majority likes — starting poll in #random: https://polls.example.com/1832
sam: cool, I'll tally tonight. no drama pls :pray:
